note: Each watched architect and lace maker's own alphabetical entries in every Wright's Directory of Nottingham held by the University of Leicester, read from the page text (not the scans), so a line can carry OCR damage and a namesake can slip in: every row links to its page. 'park' names the Park street an address mentions.
source: Wright's Directory of Nottingham, 1858 to 1915-16 — University of Leicester, Special Collections Online
